name: Bengaluru Metro Phase 3
scopeDescription: JP Nagar 4th Phase–Kempapura along Outer Ring Road West, and Hosahalli–Kadabagere along Magadi Road.
summary: Two corridors spanning 44.65 km and 31 stations. BMRCL describes Phase 3 as under construction; the publication date of that status statement is not established.

status.qualifier: BMRCL calls it under construction, but the document's exact publication date is unclear.

stationCount.qualifier: The Cabinet release is internally inconsistent on the first corridor's sub-count; the 31-station total is corroborated by BMRCL.

milestones.title: Union Cabinet approval
milestones.description: Approval announced for two elevated corridors totalling 44.65 km.
